- Then list actionable findings only. Each finding MUST be a separate top-level Markdown bullet starting with [high], [medium], or [low].

<local-command-stdout>**Verdict: approve with nits** — the interface split (`AreHooksInstalled` returning `(bool, error)`) is correctly threaded through every agent and both call sites, build/vet/tests are clean; the one substantive concern is the working-tree policy change that lets any broken `entire-agent-*` binary on `$PATH` permanently fail `disable --uninstall`.

Findings:

- **cmd/entire/cli/setup.go:2429 [medium]** — Ungated `DiscoverAndRegisterAlways` (setup.go:2408) plus the new "any unchecked agent blocks *not installed* and fails the run" rule means one unrelated broken plugin on `$PATH` makes `entire disable --uninstall` exit non-zero in *every* repo, forever. With `--force` it deletes nothing and still fails; without `--force` a non-TTY caller now gets "No terminal available to confirm the uninstall" where it previously got a clean "Entire is not installed in this repository." `--strict` was removed, so there is no escape. The commit being reversed documented exactly this hazard. Restrict the veto to unchecked built-ins.
- **cmd/entire/cli/setup.go:2427 [low]** — Comment claims the removal "attempts (built-in)" an unchecked built-in; `uninstallAgentHooks` only warns (setup.go:2775), and a test pins the no-attempt behaviour. Misleading for the next editor.
- **cmd/entire/cli/agent/cursor/hooks.go:304 [low]** — Parse failures use bare `parse hook config: %w` (also codex 256/262/273, geminicli 431, factoryaidroid 425) while read failures include the path, so the user-facing "could not check whether X hooks are installed" warning never names the file they must fix.
- **.entire/settings.json:6 [low]** — Uncommitted change adds a personal `review_default_profile` / `review_profiles.list` to repo-shared settings; belongs in the gitignored `settings.local.json`.
- **docs/architecture/agent-guide.md:417 [low]** — Template still shows `AreHooksInstalled() bool`, which no longer satisfies `HookSupport`.
- **cmd/entire/cli/uninstall_output.go:137 [low]** — `\r\x1b[2K` clears one row only; a wrapped progress line (narrow terminal + a plugin running near the 30s timeout) leaves residue above the outcome line.</local-command-stdout>
